edits.value_json: "For the Warring States forms, one analysis identifies 不 as the sound element. A competing proposal treats it as a remnant of a felled tree in a hollowed-tree vessel; the evidence does not settle its role in the earliest form."
"The Warring States analysis treats 不 as a sound element. Another proposal sees it as a tree remnant in a hollowed-tree vessel; its role in the earliest form remains unsettled."

"杯 is used as a classifier for cupfuls in examples cited from Mencius and later works. These attestations do not establish when this use developed relative to the vessel sense or establish present-day Chinese use."

"The Warring States analysis treats 不 as the sound element in 杯. Zhengzhang’s reconstructions support a proposed sound-series relation, while a competing hollowed-tree interpretation treats 不 as a tree remnant; neither settles its role in the earliest form."
